1531-4279-6026--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1531-4279-6026--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Deathgreeter, Field of Souls and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Deathgreeter trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Field of Souls ability, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Deathgreeter triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2577-5670-6094.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2577-5670-6094.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

2438-3197-6854--196.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Herd Baloth enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Host of the Hereafter triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 5.

757-1543-2348-5087.easyPrerequisites: Magosi has at least one eon counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
757-1543-2348-5087.description:
During your precombat main phase, use Ichormoon Gauntlet to put an additional eon counter on Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it and returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Magosi leaves the battlefield, The Ozolith's first ability triggers due to Nature's Revolt, putting an eon counter on The Ozolith.
Resolve the Magosi ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Ozolith triggers, moving an eon counter from itself onto Magosi.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to either Kiora's Follower or Ioreth of the Healing House

116-1432-7786.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Ioreth of the Healing House.
If Kiora's Follower has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
If Ioreth of the Healing House has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Ioreth of the Healing House ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

64-4872-7370.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Warden of the Eye.
Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Warden of the Eye from exile to the battlefield.
When Warden of the Eye enters, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

2919-3641-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-3641-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

81-1887-3099-4762.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Kami of Whispered Hopes and Vorinclex.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

4050-7364-7487.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Zealous Lorecaster and another nontoken creature, adding {1}{W}.
Cast Continue? by paying {1}{W}, returning Zealous Lorecaster and at least one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Zealous Lorecaster enters, it triggers, returning Continue? from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
4050-7364-7487.notes: You can sacrifice up to two additional creatures each loop to net mana.

1309-4872-5144.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Salvager of Secrets and exiling Ephemerate.
When Salvager of Secrets enters, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Salvager of Secrets.
When Salvager of Secrets enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1394-2060-5231-5902-7038.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Innkeeper's Talent.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Innkeeper's Talent.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 9 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

628-2511-7194.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Burdened Stoneback.
When Burdened Stoneback dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability
Repeat.

1409-2499-6463.description:
Activate Meticulous Artisan by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Meticulous Artisan enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Meticulous Artisan.
Resolve both Meticulous Artisan triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1726-2981-6972.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Scrapyard Recombiner.
When Scrapyard Recombiner dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Scrapyard Recombiner's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Scrapyard Recombiner from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.

2366-4050-4875-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-4050-4875-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1479-2638-2841-6158.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Blighted Woodland.
1479-2638-2841-6158.description:
Fetch a land using Blighted Woodland.
When the fetched land enters, Tireless Tracker and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Tireless Tracker trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Tireless Tracker triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

2342-4924-7070.description:
Activate Shaman en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Shaman en-Kor.
The Shaman en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Shaman en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Heartless Summoning.
Repeat.

813-6103-6492-7068.description:
Cast Illusion of Choice by paying {U}, allowing you to decide how each player votes this turn and causing you to draw a a card.
Cast Plea for Power by paying {3}{U}, choosing all votes to be for time, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Baboon Spirit by paying {3}{U}, exiling Scholar of the Ages.
At the beginning of your end step, Baboon Spirit triggers, returning Scholar of the Ages from exile to the battlefield.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Illusion of Choice and Plea for Power from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

2047-2103-2707-6504.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Capture of Jingzhou each turn.
2047-2103-2707-6504.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers, creating a token copy of Conjurer's Bauble.
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate the Conjurer's Bauble token by tapping and sacrificing it, putting Capture of Jingzhou onto the bottom of your library from your graveyard, and then causing you to draw Capture of Jingzhou from the bottom of your library due to River Song.
Repeat each turn.

1202-1737-2829-4853.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Myr Moonvessel.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Myr Moonvessel.
When Myr Moonvessel dies, Myr Moonvessel and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Myr Moonvessel trigger, adding {C}.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Prototype Portal.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

647-2105-3204-4251.notablePrerequisites:
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Godo or Combat Celebrant must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
647-2105-3204-4251.description:
Declare either Godo or Combat Celebrant and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Godo or Combat Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Godo or Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Godo or Combat Celebrant from the battlefield, and then returning Godo or Combat Celebrant from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

372-1809-3556.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Flicker exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1809-3556.description:
Cast Flicker by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Returned Pastcaller and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Returned Pastcaller trigger.
Resolve the Returned Pastcaller trigger, returning Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Flicker.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Returned Pastcaller and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1661-2034-2452-3651.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Aphetto Vulture, adding {C}{C}.
Aphetto Vulture dies, putting itself on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Aphetto Vulture from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

191-1689-2836.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in your hand greater than your maximum hand size.
191-1689-2836.description:
During your cleanup step, discard to your maximum hand size.
When you discard a card, Curator of Mysteries triggers, causing you to draw a card due to Eligeth.
Pass priority, moving to an additional cleanup step.
Repeat until there are no cards left in your library.
Laboratory Maniac's effect causes you to win the game.

239-1636-2273-2467.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional Sliver.
An additional Sliver with mana value 1 in library.
239-1636-2273-2467.description:
Activate all Slivers you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}.
Activate Sliver Overlord's first ability by paying {3}, searching your library for a Sliver with mana value 1.
Cast that Sliver by paying {1}.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat, gaining {1} more each time in step 1 and searching for a Sliver costing up to {1} more each time in step 2.

2034-2451-2479-3069.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six Swamps.
2034-2451-2479-3069.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Magus of the Coffers, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Magus of the Coffers' unearth ability by paying {2}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield, giving it haste and exiling it at end of turn or when it leaves the battlefield.
Activate Magus of the Coffers by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least six {B}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Magus of the Coffers, adding {C}{C}.
Both Magus of the Coffers's undying ability and Void Maw attempt to exile Magus of the Coffers when it would be put into your graveyard.
Choose to apply the Void Maw replacement effect, exiling Magus of the Coffers.
Activate Void Maw by putting Magus of the Coffers from exile into your graveyard, giving Void Maw +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 2.

3756-3932-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Hope Tender does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Hope Tender.
You control an additional land that can tap for mana.
3756-3932-4222.description:
Activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding {U}{R} .
Activate your additional land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Hope Tender's last ability by paying {1}, tapping it, and exerting it, untapping Izzet Boilerworks and a land that can tap for mana.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Hope Tender.
Repeat any number of times.
